gemini_description.purpose: To illustrate the electrical terminal wiring configurations and schematic diagrams for connecting single-phase and three-phase motors.
gemini_description.summary: This diagram provides the standard terminal block wiring layouts and electrical schematics for single-phase and three-phase AC motors. It includes single-phase wiring with an external capacitor, and three-phase wiring supporting both Delta (triangle symbol) and Star (Y symbol) terminal configurations, alongside their respective power line and protective grounding schemes.

components.name: Single Phase Terminal Block
components.description: Terminal block showing connection points for Line (L) and Neutral (N) along with an external capacitor connection.

components.name: Capacitor
components.description: An electrical component used in the single-phase motor circuit to provide the phase shift necessary to start and run the motor.

components.name: Delta Terminal Block Configuration
components.description: Terminal block setup using three vertical metal jumper links to connect the motor windings in a Delta configuration, connected to lines L1, L2, and L3.

components.name: Star (Wye) Terminal Block Configuration
components.description: Terminal block setup using horizontal metal jumper links across the top three terminals to connect the motor windings in a Star (Y) configuration, connected to lines L1, L2, and L3.

components.name: Grounding Connection
components.description: Protective earth ground symbols indicated near the terminal blocks and motor chassis for safety.

components.name: Single Phase Motor (M)
components.description: Single-phase AC motor schematic including an internal thermal protector (H) and capacitor (C).

components.name: Three Phase Motor (M3)
components.description: Standard three-phase AC induction motor schematic.

components.name: Contactor/Switch (S)
components.description: Inline switch or contactor contacts used to control the single-phase motor circuit.

components.name: Motor Protective Circuit Breaker
components.description: Includes disconnect contacts, thermal overload, and magnetic short-circuit trip mechanisms for protecting the three-phase motor.

procedure: To wire a single-phase terminal block, connect Line (L) and Neutral (N) to the designated terminals, and bridge the capacitor across the specified terminals as shown in the top diagram.

To wire a three-phase motor in Delta (Δ) configuration, install three parallel vertical metal jumpers across the terminal studs, and connect incoming power lines L1, L2, and L3 to the bottom terminals.

To wire a three-phase motor in Star (Y) configuration, install horizontal metal jumpers across the top row of terminal studs to form a star point, and connect power lines L1, L2, and L3 to the bottom row of terminals.

For the single-phase system schematic, route Line (L1) and Neutral (N) through the switch contacts (S) to power the single-phase motor (M) containing thermal protector (H) and capacitor (C). Connect the motor chassis to ground.
For the three-phase system schematic, route phases R, S, and T through the protective circuit breaker and overloads to the three-phase motor (M3). Connect the motor chassis to ground.

technical_details.detail: Supported three-phase layouts include Delta (represented by the triangle symbol) and Star (represented by the Y symbol).
Incoming three-phase lines are designated as L1, L2, L3 in the connection blocks, and as R, S, T in the schematic.
Terminology is provided in multiple languages: English, French, Spanish, Italian, German, Greek, Russian, and Arabic.

warnings.warning: Ensure correct positioning of jumper links (vertical for Delta, horizontal for Star) according to the rated voltage on the motor nameplate before applying power.
Ensure all motor frames are securely connected to the protective earth ground as indicated by the ground symbols to prevent shock hazards.
